description: Runs Audora's own lookup of what the artist has already published (streaming profiles, releases, their site and social profiles), or reads where one is and what it found. Use it only when you cannot search the web yourself: otherwise look the artist up with your own search, check with them that you found the right artist, and fill their page with update_profile. With action "start" it begins one, which takes 1–2 minutes; the artist gets a few a day, shared with Soundcheck in Audora. The account's first lookup is free and each later one costs credits and needs the artist's spend permission: start with dry_run: true to read the price, tell the artist, then start with confirm_cost_credits. With action "status" (the default) it reads the newest lookup, or the one named by run_id. Every fact comes with the pages it was read on. It never changes the artist's profile: when it is done, call propose_profile so the artist keeps what is theirs in Audora.

action.description: "start" a new lookup, or read its "status". Default: status.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

confirm_cost_credits.description: For start: the price a dry run quoted and you told the artist. Needed for a lookup that is not free.

dry_run.description: For start: true to read what the lookup costs without starting it.

link.description: For start: one page the artist is on (Apple Music, Deezer, SoundCloud, YouTube, Bandcamp, their site, Instagram), as a full https:// address. It is the best starting point. A Spotify link is kept as theirs but never opened, so another page starts the lookup better.

not_me.description: For start: names of earlier matches the artist said are not them.

run_id.description: For status: a particular lookup. Default: the newest.

name: find_online
title: Look the artist up online
